pages_c05.c5p100/s299w32: Tibetan 'sogs' at [275, 279]; English 'and so on' at [521, 530]. sogs follows nus pa after the coordinated hair, bite and mirage-water examples and closes that list. The English and so on is the same closing gesture, not an unlicensed new nominal head.
pages_c05.c5p100/s300w10: Tibetan 'sogs' at [62, 66]; English 'or the like' at [99, 110]. The initial sogs follows dud 'gro and closes the pleasure being/human/craving spirit/animal enumeration. Its English or the like is the local list extension, distinct from both later source occurrences.
pages_c05.c5p100/s300w47: Tibetan 'la sogs pa' at [394, 404]; English 'and so on' at [854, 863]. la sogs pa follows me tshogs and closes the burning-steel/sword-forest/fire enumeration. It licenses the final English and so on; the earlier sogs following rnag khrag is omitted and is not reused here.
